_about: The test-links page (test-links.html) reads this list: Karl's change list. Live = on the site for everyone. Testing = behind a flag, waiting for Karl to keep or retire it. Retired = deleted. Every build adds or updates its entries (CLAUDE.md, Working with Karl). Each entry is a name, one plain sentence (`about`) and, for Live and Testing, its buttons. A button's `query` is the part after the address: card, level, seed, flags, sign-in skipped. `level` in a link is the saved level number (Add to both sides and Divide it: link level 2 is shown as Level 1). `reset: true` clears this browser's progress first; `look` is one sentence on what to look for; `notLive` says plainly why a link won't work on the live site.

items.name: The light design (Build D, Part 1)
items.about: No banner: every message is a pop-up; one green button right of x =; the narrow panel with its small lights; help tucked in the corner; no number pad on a keyboard.

links.label: Add · Level 1 · x + 8 = 11
links.look: A small “Find the value of x.” goes at your first action. The header fades after 3 seconds (move to the top to bring it back). Type straight from the keyboard: no pad.

links.label: The one green button
links.look: Hover near Add: the preview starts faintly, then fully on the icon. Click Add, type −8: the button says Go. Enter: it says Next. Enter, type −12: Check, then Next, then Next problem. Always the same place.

links.label: An error below the work
links.look: Add 8 and Enter: the page dims, +16 is lit with “got bigger” under it, the message is below the work and an arrow hops at Undo.

links.label: Partly cancelled
links.look: Add −5: “still here” sits under the +3, not on it.

links.label: The move after a correct guess
links.look: Type −12, Enter four times, then Next problem: everything greys except the problem and the moves, with “Your mental math is very strong.” Hover Add: its preview is lit too. Next or a move brings everything back.

links.label: Help in the corner
links.look: Wait 10 seconds: I’m stuck flashes gently. Teach me appears (and flashes) only after a second error: try Add 8, Undo, Add 8.

links.label: Divide it in the light design
links.look: The same frame: the narrow panel (Multiply is the live move), x = with the green button, help in the corner, the counters on the right when you ask for help.

items.name: Checking a value side by side (Build D, Part 2)
items.about: Check greys the page except the original equation and the space to its right; drag your value into x, and the check is written beside the equation, one step a Next.

links.label: A right answer
links.look: Add −8, Enter, Enter, type 3, Check: drag the 3 into x (or tap x): (3) + 8 = 11 appears on the right; Next, Next: Balanced.

links.label: The opposite (−8)
links.look: Type −8 and Check, drag it into x, Next, Next: “−8 is an important number…”. Undo: the hint lights Add with −8 already in its blank.

links.label: Added sizes (19)
links.look: Add −8, Enter, Enter, type 19, Check, drag, Next, Next: “When x = 19, the equation is not balanced.” Undo: 11 − 8: party or battle? right above the numbers.

links.label: Any other wrong value
links.look: Type 4, Check, drag, Next, Next: “When x = 4, the equation is not balanced.” Undo: the usual reminder at the +8.

links.label: Divide it
links.look: Type 4, Check, drag the 4 into the x of 5x: 5 × 4 = −15 is written on the right, then 20 = −15, Not balanced.

items.name: Dragging terms: see where it lands (Build D, Part 3)
items.about: While you drag a term, the equation it would make shows in grey right under it; the token is green while positive and turns red with its new sign across the line; the line shows only while dragging.

links.label: Drag a number
links.look: Drag the + 8: before x the grey row shows 8 + x; over the line it turns red (− 8) and the grey row shows x = −8 + 11 or x = 11 − 8, depending on where you hold it.

links.label: x stays
links.look: Drag x across the line: “x is already on the left side of the equation…”, no dimming.

links.label: Combine
links.look: Drag − 4 across, Next, then drop the 4 on the −3: the two are lit with Combine over them, the rest greys, a box under them; type 1 and press the green Combine. A wrong sum is an error with Undo.

links.label: Drill: finish with Flip and Multiply
links.look: At −2x = 2 a hint lights Flip everything; then Multiply, type 2 (1 over 2), Go: x = −1.

items.name: The narrow panel (was lights round 2)
items.about: Kept (Build D): the narrow panel with its small round lights is the only panel on Add to both sides and Divide it.

links.label: Narrow panel · x − 4 = −3
links.look: Hover a dot: it opens into its goal. The dashed line only shows while you drag a term.

items.name: Grab the terms (was lights round 2)
items.about: Kept (Build D): drag a number across the line, onto another number to combine, or along its side to reorder; tap a minus to see it as a negative.

links.label: Drag across, combine, minus
links.look: Drag “− 4” over the line, drop, Next, then drop the 4 onto the −3, type 1 and press the green Combine.

links.label: Reorder, and x can’t cross
links.look: Drag “+ 8” before x: 8 + x = 11 in place. Drag x across: “That moves x. Try the number.”

items.name: The Distribute drill
items.about: Kept (Build D): two drill problems solved only by grabbing terms. It has no level button; this link is the way in.

links.label: Drill: 5 − 2(x + 2) = 3
links.look: Dragging the 2 is refused until you tap its minus; then two labelled blanks, −2 and −4, and on to x = −1.

items.name: Errors pop up next to the mistake (spotlight)
items.about: A move that makes things worse dims the page, lights up what went wrong, and only Undo goes on; after Undo a hint pops up at the number to work on.

links.label: A move the wrong way
links.look: On x + 8 = −4, Add 8 and Enter: the page dims, +16 is lit with “got bigger”, the message sits beside it and Undo pulses. Press Undo (or Enter): a hint at the +8 with Got it.

links.label: Partly cancelled
links.look: Add −5 and Enter: the +3 still next to x is lit, “still here”.

links.label: A wrong guess
links.look: Type 4 and Check, click through: the “Not balanced” line is lit; Undo takes the guess back, then the hint.

links.label: A wrong value
links.look: Add −8, Enter, Enter, then type 19 and Check, click through: x = is lit, “check this”; Undo closes it and says to work out x.

links.label: Divide: a fraction that doesn’t split
links.look: Take a fraction, ½: the failed row is lit, “doesn’t split”; after Undo the 5 is outlined and Take a fraction is highlighted.

items.name: Help when x is alone: party or battle, then counters
items.about: At x = 11 + −8, I’m stuck asks “party or battle?” right at the two numbers, then says “Now type x.”; asked again, Count it’s counters appear in a small tray above the numbers.

links.label: x = 11 + −8
links.look: Add −8, Enter, Enter, then I’m stuck: pick Battle (a wrong pick gets a nudge), then I’m stuck again: draw 11 + counters and 8 − counters, Check, cancel the pairs, count, type 3. The app never writes 3.

links.label: Teach me starts at the counters
links.look: Add −8, Enter, Enter, then Teach me: the counters tray opens straight away, with its own Party or Battle step.

items.name: Add to both sides: preview on hover, fill the blank
items.about: Every level now plays this way: hover Add to see the move on the equation, type the amount in the box in that row, then press the green Next.

links.label: Level 1 · x + 8 = 11
links.look: No Guess x / Use a move buttons: the line just says “Find x.”, and both Add and x = work at once.

links.label: Level 3 · x + 8 = −4
links.look: The same screen on the mixed level (it used to be the old screen).

links.label: Level 5 · bigger
links.look: The same screen on the last level.

items.name: Trade places when x is on the right
items.about: From Level 4, when x is on the right, the line asks you to trade places first; Add waits until you do.

links.label: Level 4 · −2 = x + −6
links.look: Click Add first: it says to trade places. Click the Trade places move (it pulses): the sides swap, then Add works.

items.name: The move after a correct guess
items.about: Guess right and the next problem must be shown with a move: the move has a steady ring and x = stays grey until you make one.

links.label: Guess, then the next problem
links.look: Type −12 and Check, click through, then Next problem: Add has a ring, x = is grey with “Make one move first.”, until a good move and Next.

items.name: Divide it: no choice
items.about: Divide it has no Guess x / Use a move either: the fraction move and x = are both live from the start.

links.label: Divide it · Level 2 · 5x = −15
links.look: The line says “Find x.”; you can type a guess or pick Take a fraction straight away.

items.name: Level 1 is problems; the walkthrough is “See why it works”
items.about: Add to both sides and Divide it open on real problems; the numbers-only walkthrough is a small button on the card.

links.label: Home screen, as a brand-new student
links.look: Hover Solve it: both cards start at Level 1 with a “See why it works” button by the dots. Open it, reload: you land on the home screen.

links.label: Add to both sides · See why it works
links.look: The header says “See why it works”: the balance walkthrough.

links.label: Divide it · See why it works
links.look: The header says “See why it works”: the numbers-only walkthrough.

items.name: Help that reads the equation on screen (Build A)
items.about: I'm stuck now uses the numbers on screen, says Undo first after a bad move, and never writes the answer.

links.label: Partly cancelled: Undo first
links.look: On x + 8 = −4 add −5 (Enter), then I’m stuck: it names the +3 that’s left and says to press Undo first.

links.label: Divide it: a fraction that doesn’t split
links.look: On 5x = −15 take ½ (it fails), then I’m stuck: it says to press Undo first.

items.name: Every level
items.about: One button per level of the two Solve it cards, on the same problems every time.

items.name: The banner
items.about: The yellow message box at the top of Add to both sides and Divide it is deleted: every message is a pop-up (Build D).

items.name: The wide Move / Why? panel
items.about: Replaced on both cards by the narrow panel with its small lights (Build D).

items.name: The ✓ under the blank, and the separate Next and Check buttons
items.about: One green button right of x = does all of it (Build D).

items.name: The ?ui=grab link
items.about: Not needed any more: round 2 is how Add to both sides plays (Build D).

items.name: Guess x / Use a move
items.about: The choice at the start of every Solve it problem is deleted on Add to both sides and Divide it (Build C).

items.name: The tucked layout
items.about: The Divide it pilot with the slim Why? column, Moves drawer and counter tray (?layout=tucked) is deleted (Build C).

items.name: The ?ui=lights link
items.about: Not needed any more: what it showed is now how Add to both sides always plays (see Live).

items.name: The move owed on the same problem
items.about: Lights round 1 asked for the move on the same problem after a correct guess; now it is the next problem, as everywhere else.
